post.description: **host.catalog.manage** (first-party): Keep OpenVibe.Host's hosting catalog (plan T20 step 3: hosting compared): create and edit providers (with their affiliate link and the exact disclosure), staff-entered plans (each with its source URL, currency, monthly price and the date it was confirmed; a plan that came from OpenVibe.Sources takes only a status change) and promotions. Held by Network staff users only. The catalog's reads are public and need no capability.

get.summary: Manage OpenVibe.Host's owner settings (D11): GET /internal/owner-settings answers platform.owner-settings@1 and PATCH changes typed values with platform.owner-settings-change@1 (a key with source env
get.description: **host.settings.manage** (internal): Manage OpenVibe.Host's owner settings (D11): GET /internal/owner-settings answers platform.owner-settings@1 and PATCH changes typed values with platform.owner-settings-change@1 (a key with source env is 409 settings.pinned_in_env); PUT /internal/owner-settings/secrets/:key sets a secret once with platform.owner-secret-put@1 (write-only) and DELETE removes it. The first set is the inference planner, its budget and the demand source. Only Network's admin proxy, acting for the owner, holds this capability; it is never grantable to apps. Each request carries the owner as actor, and the service audits every write with that actor and key, never the value.

key.description: The setting key, as platform.owner-settings@1 names it.

value.description: The new typed value. A nano_usd value is an integer string; a float is never a value.

parameters.name: reason

schema.description: Why the owner changed it; recorded in the service's audit line.

parameters.description: Why the owner changed it; recorded in the service's audit line.

errors.problem.v1.title: Problem
errors.problem.v1.description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a stable OpenVibe error code and trace identifiers. The legacy 'error' string is allowed during migration so existing clients keep working.

error.description: Deprecated compatibility field: same text as title/detail for clients that read {error}.

host.catalog-manage-request.v1.title: HostCatalogManageRequest
host.catalog-manage-request.v1.description: host.catalog-manage-request@1: bodies of host.catalog.manage on OpenVibe.Host (a Network staff user only). POST/PATCH /api/v1/catalog/providers { slug, name, homepage_url, description?, affiliate_url?, affiliate_note?, status? }; POST/PATCH /api/v1/catalog/plans { provider_id, external_id, name, kind, currency, price_monthly, source_url, vcpu?, ram_mb?, disk_gb?, disk_type?, bandwidth_gb?, unmetered?, port_mbps?, ipv4?, locations?, price_hourly?, setup_fee?, checked_at?, status? } (a plan from OpenVibe.Sources takes only status); POST/PATCH /api/v1/catalog/promos { provider_id, title, url, details?, code?, affiliate?, starts_at?, ends_at?, status? }. A PATCH carries any subset. Unknown fields are refused (422 host.catalog.invalid); a missing entry is 404 host.catalog.not_found; anyone but staff is 403 host.catalog.forbidden. A staff plan's checked_at defaults to now: the staff member confirming the price that day.

affiliate_note.description: The exact disclosure shown beside the provider's affiliate links.

checked_at.description: Epoch milliseconds the price was confirmed.

host.catalog-manage-result.v1.title: HostCatalogManageResult
host.catalog-manage-result.v1.description: host.catalog-manage-result@1: the saved entry, under its type's name: { provider } (with affiliate_rel and affiliate_disclosure when it has an affiliate link), { plan } or { promo } (an active promo past ends_at reads as ended). 201 on create, 200 on update.

platform.owner-settings-change.v1.title: PlatformOwnerSettingsChange
platform.owner-settings-change.v1.description: platform.owner-settings-change@1 (AI Exchange D11): body of PATCH /internal/owner-settings on each service that owns owner settings. It changes one or more typed values at once. A key whose setting has source env is pinned and the service answers 409 settings.pinned_in_env; a secret-type setting is never changed here (use platform.owner-secret-put@1). Each request carries the owner as actor and the service audits every change with that actor and key, never the value.

key.description: The setting key, as platform.owner-settings@1 names it.

value.description: The new typed value. A nano_usd value is an integer string; a float is never a value.

reason.description: Why the owner changed it; recorded in the service's audit line.

type.description: The owner; a service or an app is never the actor.

platform.owner-settings.v1.title: PlatformOwnerSettings
platform.owner-settings.v1.description: platform.owner-settings@1 (AI Exchange D11): one service's owner settings document, answered by GET/PATCH /internal/owner-settings and by PUT/DELETE /internal/owner-settings/secrets/:key on the service that owns the settings. A setting is typed and says where its effective value comes from; `env` pins it read-only. A secret setting never carries its value (and never a default): only the write-only metadata `secret`. nano_usd values are integer strings, never numbers. Only Network's admin proxy, acting for the owner, reads or writes this document.

service.description: The service whose settings these are, e.g. ai.

groups.description: The groups the settings are shown under.

settings.description: Every setting the service exposes to the owner.

id.description: Stable group id; a setting names it in `group`.

nano-usd.description: Integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD) as a decimal string (D1). Never a number or a float.

https-origin.description: An https origin: scheme, host and optional port, with no path, query or fragment.

set.description: Whether a value is sealed in the owning service.

hint.description: A short hint (the last four characters), never the value.

fingerprint.description: A keyed HMAC-SHA-256 fingerprint, 16 hex characters: tells whether two keys are the same without revealing either.

bound_to.description: The destination origin the value is sealed to; absent or null when unbound.

group.description: The id of the setting's group.

enum.description: The allowed values; present only when type is enum.

min.description: The smallest allowed value; present only when type is integer or nano_usd.

max.description: The largest allowed value; present only when type is integer or nano_usd.

value.description: The effective typed value; absent for type secret.

default.description: The typed default; absent for type secret.

source.description: env pins the setting read-only and wins; owner is a value the owner set; default is the built-in default.

env.description: The environment variable that pins the setting; present when source is env.

danger.description: A write needs a fresh sign-in (and an operator alert).

restart.description: A change takes effect only after the service restarts.

secret.description: Write-only metadata; present only when type is secret.

openvibeToken.description: An OpenVibe Network token for this service: a person's token, an app token (client credentials, audience of the service) or a first-party service token. Its `cap` claim must include the capability the operation names.
